Thailand: Thai land: freehold blocked for foreigners, but Thai-company structure (49% farang / 51% Thai) is standard for coastal properties. Friction moderate, not blocking.
New Zealand: NZ: Overseas Investment Act 2018 blocks residential; rural land needs OIO consent + benefit-to-NZ test. Effectively -25 vs unrestricted.
Portugal: Portugal: freehold for anyone; Golden Visa no longer covers residential real estate (post-2024).
Romania: EU citizens: freehold OK. Non-EU: needs RO company structure (unless reciprocity treaty).
Chile: Chile: freehold OK. Border zone (10km from AR/PE/BO border) needs presidential decree for foreigners.
French Polynesia: Tahiti: freehold available for non-French but permit process complex.
Turkey: 30 ha cap for foreigners + military-zone exclusions; reciprocity rule
Poland: EU: freehold. Non-EU: needs Ministry permit for ag-land >1ha; border/coastal land restricted.
Fiji: Fiji: mostly native lease (99-year); freehold rare and iTaukei consent required for coastal.
New Caledonia: French territory: freehold available for anyone.
Japan: no restrictions, full freehold for foreigners
Australia: FIRB approval required for non-resident purchases.
Vanuatu: Vanuatu: NO freehold for non-citizens; 75-year lease max.
Austria: AT: non-EU buyers need Ausländergrunderwerbsgesetz permit per state. Vorarlberg + Tirol very restrictive; Kärnten more open. Tourist-zone chalets often easier.
Switzerland: CH: non-residents restricted by Lex Koller. Alpine resort communes have annual foreign-purchase quotas (mostly filled). Buy via commercial (chalet-hotel operator) or holiday-home authorization.
Georgia: GE: foreigners can hold urban land freehold. Agricultural land (>5ha) restricted to Georgian citizens — mountain plots often OK if <5ha.
